description: Curated contribution records shared by the README, paper browser, and taxonomy tree. Description sources are recorded in data/paper_details.json.

entries.title: VidHalluc: Evaluating Temporal Hallucinations in Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Understanding
entries.name: VidHalluc
entries.description: Evaluates hallucinations about actions, temporal order, and scene transitions through video questions, caption generation, and event sorting.

entries.title: Exploring Hallucination of Large Multimodal Models in Video Understanding: Benchmark, Analysis and Mitigation
entries.name: HAVEN
entries.description: Diagnoses video hallucinations by crossing hallucination causes, object-scene-event aspects, and question formats to expose distinct failures in video understanding.

entries.title: MHBench: Demystifying Motion Hallucination in VideoLLMs
entries.name: MHBench
entries.description: Tests motion hallucinations using original actions, actions with reversed meanings, and incomplete actions that challenge static visual cues.

entries.title: KPM-Bench: A Kinematic Parsing Motion Benchmark for Fine-grained Motion-centric Video Understanding
entries.name: KPM-Bench
entries.description: Evaluates fine-grained limb motion through video captioning and question answering, using kinematic parsing to assess motion descriptions.

entries.title: ARGUS: Hallucination and Omission Evaluation in Video-LLMs
entries.name: ARGUS
entries.description: Measures both fabricated content and missing information in free-form video captions against human-written reference descriptions.

entries.title: MotionHalluc: Diagnosing Kinematic Hallucinations in Fine-Grained Motion Reasoning
entries.name: MotionHalluc
entries.description: Diagnoses fine-grained motion hallucinations involving direction, attribution, and temporal kinematics, separating distinct failures in interpreting physical movement.

entries.title: MoHallBench: A Benchmark for Motion Hallucination in Video Large Language Models
entries.name: MoHallBench
entries.description: Probes motion hallucinations caused by prior knowledge, sequential inference, and visual similarity through several question formats.

entries.title: VideoHallucer: Evaluating Intrinsic and Extrinsic Hallucinations in Large Video-Language Models
entries.name: VideoHallucer
entries.description: Uses adversarial question pairs to distinguish hallucinations about visible objects and temporal relations from unsupported external information.

entries.title: Online Video Understanding: OVBench and VideoChat-Online
entries.name: OVBench
entries.description: Evaluates streaming-video question answering across online perception, memory, and reasoning tasks; its scope extends beyond hallucination-specific evaluation.

entries.title: VidHal: Benchmarking Temporal Hallucinations in Vision LLMs
entries.name: VidHal
entries.description: Evaluates temporal hallucinations by asking models to distinguish and rank video captions with different degrees of factual distortion.

entries.title: Vript: A Video Is Worth Thousands of Words
entries.name: Vript
entries.description: Provides dense video descriptions and Vript-Hard evaluations targeting hallucinated captions, information retrieval, and temporal ordering of video events.

entries.title: EGOILLUSION: Benchmarking Hallucinations in Egocentric Video Understanding
entries.name: EGOILLUSION
entries.description: Tests hallucinations in first-person videos through human-annotated open and closed questions about visual and auditory evidence.

entries.title: MESH -- Understanding Videos Like Human: Measuring Hallucinations in Large Video Models
entries.name: MESH
entries.description: Uses hierarchical questions and plausible distractors to expose hallucinations about objects, attributes, and subject-action relations across video segments.

entries.title: TOC-Bench: A Temporal Object Consistency Benchmark for Video Large Language Models
entries.name: TOC-Bench
entries.description: Tests object identity, state, and continuity with trajectory-grounded questions designed to require temporally ordered visual evidence.

entries.title: STRAND: Benchmarking and Improving Object-Centric Spatio-Temporal Monitoring in Video Large Language Models
entries.name: STRAND
entries.description: Evaluates object-state changes, identity persistence, and relational reasoning, requiring answers to satisfy jointly grounded spatiotemporal prerequisites.

entries.title: ELV-Halluc: Benchmarking Semantic Aggregation Hallucinations in Long Video Understanding
entries.name: ELV-Halluc
entries.description: Tests hallucinations from semantic aggregation in long videos, where models can incorrectly combine information across separate video segments.

entries.title: Pop-Up Distractions Reveal Bag-of-Events Behavior in Video Large Language Models
entries.name: DistractionBench
entries.description: Inserts advertising distractors into long videos to test whether models conflate subjects and events from unrelated segments.

entries.title: GameplayQA: A Benchmarking Framework for Decision-Dense POV-Synced Multi-Video Understanding of 3D Virtual Agents
entries.name: GameplayQA
entries.description: Uses synchronized multiplayer gameplay views and structured distractors to test agent identity, role attribution, and grounded reasoning.

entries.title: VideoHallu: Evaluating and Mitigating Multi-modal Hallucinations on Synthetic Video Understanding
entries.name: VideoHallu
entries.description: Tests prior-driven hallucinations using synthetic videos that violate physical or logical expectations, challenging models to follow observed evidence.

entries.title: Models See Hallucinations: Evaluating the Factuality in Video Captioning
entries.name: FactVC
entries.description: Studies factual errors in video captions and introduces a weakly supervised factuality metric with human-annotated evaluation data.

entries.title: Beyond Binary Preferences: Graded Preference Optimization for Limb-Motion Captioning
entries.name: FlexBench
entries.description: Evaluates person-specific limb-motion captions across shots, distinguishing omissions from fabricated or incorrect actions through graded physical alignment.

entries.title: EventHallusion: Diagnosing Event Hallucinations in Video LLMs
entries.name: EventHallusion
entries.description: Diagnoses event hallucinations driven by language priors and visual biases, testing whether answers reflect events actually present in videos.

entries.title: NOAH: Benchmarking Narrative Prior driven Hallucination and Omission in Video Large Language Models
entries.name: NOAH
entries.description: Inserts unrelated clips into videos to measure narrative-prior hallucinations and omissions through captioning and question-answering tasks.

entries.title: RoadSocial: A Diverse VideoQA Dataset and Benchmark for Road Event Understanding from Social Video Narratives
entries.name: RoadSocial
entries.description: Provides diverse social-media road videos and question-answer pairs for evaluating road-event understanding across viewpoints and geographic settings.

entries.title: CCTVBench: Contrastive Consistency Traffic VideoQA Benchmark for Multimodal LLMs
entries.name: CCTVBench
entries.description: Tests consistent traffic-hazard judgments using real accident videos paired with counterfactual counterparts that alter the evidence for an accident.

entries.title: VidOmni-Bench: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Video Understanding via Spatio-Temporal Event Verification across Complexity and Duration
entries.name: VidOmni-Bench
entries.description: Tests whether models can verify individual events in dense video captions, using human-checked incorrect descriptions as hard negatives.

entries.title: INFACT: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Induced Faithfulness and Factuality Hallucinations in Video-LLMs
entries.name: INFACT
entries.description: Separates faithfulness from factuality errors in video answers and probes robustness to degraded visuals, corrupted evidence, and temporal interventions.

entries.title: Learning to Decode Against Compositional Hallucination in Video Multimodal Large Language Models
entries.name: OmniVCHall
entries.description: Benchmarks isolated and compositional hallucinations across spatial and temporal dimensions, probing failures involving multiple interacting types of video evidence.

entries.title: VideoHEDGE: Entropy-Based Hallucination Detection for Video-VLMs via Semantic Clustering and Spatiotemporal Perturbations
entries.name: VideoHEDGE
entries.description: Estimates answer reliability by clustering responses to clean and perturbed videos and measuring semantic uncertainty across those responses.

entries.title: DualFact+: A Multimodal Fact Verification Framework for Procedural Video Understanding
entries.name: DualFact
entries.description: Evaluates procedural-caption factuality at conceptual and grounded argument levels, using either textual references or direct video evidence.

entries.title: Spatiotemporal Sycophancy: Negation-Based Gaslighting in Video Large Language Models
entries.name: GasVideo-1000
entries.description: Tests whether misleading conversational feedback causes video models to abandon correct judgments and invent unsupported spatiotemporal explanations.

entries.title: When Text Hijacks Vision: Benchmarking and Mitigating Text Overlay-Induced Hallucination in Vision Language Models
entries.name: VisualTextTrap
entries.description: Tests whether misleading text overlays cause video models to contradict visual evidence when answering questions about the depicted content.

entries.title: No Place to Hide: Benchmarking Video Hallucination with Background-Controlled Pairs
entries.name: VidPair-Halluc
entries.description: Uses adversarial video pairs with similar backgrounds but different foreground events to isolate spatial and temporal hallucinations.

entries.title: Target-Checked Reliability Score Refinement for Video Question Answering
entries.name: VHD
entries.description: Provides controlled video-question examples of confident but incorrect answers for diagnosing hallucinations and evaluating the reliability of confidence estimates.

entries.title: Can We Trust Video Hallucination Detectors? VidHalLoc for Evaluating the Evaluators
entries.name: VidHalLoc
entries.description: Compares hallucination detectors on adversarial video questions and captions, with a shared protocol spanning ontology and dynamic errors.

entries.title: AVHBench: A Cross-Modal Hallucination Benchmark for Audio-Visual Large Language Models
entries.name: AVHBench
entries.description: Evaluates audio-visual hallucinations, cross-modal matching, and reasoning through tasks that distinguish auditory evidence from visible video content.

entries.title: The Curse of Multi-Modalities: Evaluating Hallucinations of Large Multimodal Models across Language, Visual, and Audio
entries.name: CMM
entries.description: Investigates how unimodal priors and misleading correlations between language, vision, and audio cause multimodal hallucinations.

entries.title: Exploring Audio Hallucination in Egocentric Video Understanding
entries.name: Audio Hallucination QA
entries.description: Probes imagined foreground and background sounds in egocentric videos through questions targeting visible but inaudible events.

entries.title: TraceAV-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-Hop Trajectory Reasoning over Long Audio-Visual Videos
entries.name: TraceAV-Bench
entries.description: Tests multi-hop reasoning and hallucination robustness using explicit evidence trajectories distributed across long audio-visual recordings.

entries.title: CrossCheckGPT: Universal Hallucination Ranking for Multimodal Foundation Models
entries.name: AVHalluBench
entries.description: Provides an audio-visual hallucination benchmark with human judgments for evaluating whether generated descriptions remain consistent with multimodal evidence.

entries.title: Video-HolmesV2: Can MLLMs Reason with Spatio-Temporal Audio-Visual Evidence in Long Videos?
entries.name: Video-HolmesV2
entries.description: Requires long-video answers to cite precise audio-visual evidence, using evidence-aware scoring to penalize guessing and fabricated support.

entries.title: EmotionHallucer: Evaluating Emotion Hallucinations in Multimodal Large Language Models
entries.name: EmotionHallucer
entries.description: Evaluates emotion hallucinations in psychological knowledge and multimodal perception through adversarial questions about emotional cues and their interpretation.

entries.title: SEASON: Mitigating Temporal Hallucination in Video Large Language Models via Self-Diagnostic Contrastive Decoding
entries.name: SEASON
entries.description: Diagnoses hallucination tendencies token by token and adaptively contrasts temporal and spatial negatives without additional training.

entries.title: Exploring Hallucination of Large Multimodal Models in Video Understanding: Benchmark, Analysis and Mitigation
entries.name: Video-thinking (TDPO)
entries.description: Combines supervised reasoning fine-tuning with thinking-based direct preference optimization, giving fabricated reasoning stronger feedback to improve factual grounding.

entries.title: SmartSight: Mitigating Hallucination in Video-LLMs Without Compromising Video Understanding via Temporal Attention Collapse
entries.name: SmartSight
entries.description: Selects among sampled responses using temporal attention collapse and terminates unreliable generations when visual attention vanishes.

entries.title: VideoTemp-o3: Harmonizing Temporal Grounding and Video Understanding in Agentic Thinking-with-Videos
entries.name: VideoTemp-o3
entries.description: Jointly trains temporal localization and video answering so an agent can inspect relevant clips and revise inaccurate grounding.

entries.title: CounterVid: Counterfactual Video Generation for Mitigating Action and Temporal Hallucinations in Video-Language Models
entries.name: MixDPO
entries.description: Creates counterfactual action videos and jointly optimizes visual and textual preferences to reduce action and temporal-order hallucinations.

entries.title: MotionHalluc: Diagnosing Kinematic Hallucinations in Fine-Grained Motion Reasoning
entries.name: PPV
entries.description: Injects measured physical-motion evidence into video reasoning to check kinematic claims, without training or modifying the underlying video model.

entries.title: Temporal Insight Enhancement: Mitigating Temporal Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models
entries.name: Temporal Insight
entries.description: Decomposes event queries into characteristic actions and uses visual-language models to estimate timestamps for temporally grounded responses.

entries.title: VidHalluc: Evaluating Temporal Hallucinations in Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Understanding
entries.name: DINO-HEAL
entries.description: Uses DINOv2 saliency to reweight visual features during inference, emphasizing informative regions without additional training of the video model.

entries.title: Mitigating Hallucination in VideoLLMs via Temporal-Aware Activation Engineering
entries.name: TAAE
entries.description: Uses temporal variation to identify and intervene in hallucination-sensitive model activations without further fine-tuning the language model.

entries.title: VideoTIR: Accurate Understanding for Long Videos with Efficient Tool-Integrated Reasoning
entries.name: VideoTIR
entries.description: Uses reinforcement learning to coordinate retrieval of video clips, images, and regions for efficient, evidence-grounded long-video answers.

entries.title: When Thinking Hurts: Mitigating Visual Forgetting in Video Reasoning via Frame Repetition
entries.name: FrameRepeat
entries.description: Trains a lightweight scoring module to repeat useful frames during reasoning and counter drift away from visual evidence.

entries.title: Think with Grounding: Curriculum Reinforced Reasoning with Video Grounding for Long Video Understanding
entries.name: Video-TwG
entries.description: Trains long-video models to interleave reasoning with on-demand temporal grounding through a staged reinforcement-learning curriculum.

entries.title: Video Evidence to Reasoning Efficient Video Understanding via Explicit Evidence Grounding
entries.name: CoE
entries.description: Extracts compact, question-relevant visual evidence and uses reinforcement learning to anchor reasoning to the selected temporal evidence.

entries.title: Relaxing Anchor-Frame Dominance for Mitigating Hallucinations in Video Large Language Models
entries.name: DTR
entries.description: Rebalances decoder attention toward under-attended frames without training, changing visual encoding, or introducing auxiliary models.

entries.title: Reflect-R1: Evidence-Driven Reflection for Self-Correction in Long Video Understanding
entries.name: Reflect-R1
entries.description: Retrieves visual evidence to verify and arbitrate long-video answers, with separate reinforcement-learning objectives for each reflection stage.

entries.title: VTG-LLM: Integrating Timestamp Knowledge into Video LLMs for Enhanced Video Temporal Grounding
entries.name: VTG-LLM
entries.description: Improves event timestamp localization by adding explicit time information to video tokens and using slot-based visual compression.

entries.title: Vript: A Video Is Worth Thousands of Words
entries.name: Vriptor
entries.description: Trains a video captioning model on densely annotated videos to generate detailed descriptions of visual content and unfolding events.

entries.title: KPM-Bench: A Kinematic Parsing Motion Benchmark for Fine-grained Motion-centric Video Understanding
entries.name: MoPE
entries.description: Uses kinematic parsing of motion descriptions as a reinforcement-learning reward to improve fine-grained video captioning and reduce motion hallucinations.

entries.title: Vista-LLaMA: Reducing Hallucination in Video Language Models via Equal Distance to Visual Tokens
entries.name: Vista-LLaMA
entries.description: Changes visual-text attention and sequential frame projection to preserve the influence of video evidence during open-ended answer generation.

entries.title: Decoupling Perception from Reasoning for Hallucination-Resistant Video Understanding
entries.name: Video-DPL
entries.description: Separates timestamped perceptual evidence from reasoning and uses factuality-aware process rewards to train hallucination-resistant video models.

entries.title: STRAND: Benchmarking and Improving Object-Centric Spatio-Temporal Monitoring in Video Large Language Models
entries.name: STRAND (Trajectory Reasoning)
entries.description: Combines structured visual trajectories with symbolic aggregation to answer object-centric spatiotemporal questions using a fixed video-language model.

entries.title: ELV-Halluc: Benchmarking Semantic Aggregation Hallucinations in Long Video Understanding
entries.name: ELV-Halluc-DPO
entries.description: Trains on adversarial preference pairs to reduce long-video hallucinations caused by incorrectly combining semantic information across video segments.

entries.title: Online Video Understanding: OVBench and VideoChat-Online
entries.name: VideoChat-Online
entries.description: Combines pyramid memory with offline-to-online instruction training to support streaming-video perception, memory, and reasoning over continuously arriving frames.

entries.title: Mitigating Object and Action Hallucinations in Multimodal LLMs via Self-Augmented Contrastive Alignment
entries.name: SANTA
entries.description: Combines hallucination-based negative captions with tracklet-phrase contrastive alignment to improve object and action faithfulness in video descriptions.

entries.title: EventHallusion: Diagnosing Event Hallucinations in Video LLMs
entries.name: TCD
entries.description: Contrasts predictions from original and temporally disrupted video sequences during decoding to reduce event hallucinations without additional model training.

entries.title: STVG-R1: Incentivizing Instance-Level Reasoning and Grounding in Videos via Reinforcement Learning
entries.name: STVG-R1
entries.description: Replaces coordinate prediction with visually prompted object identities and reinforcement learning for spatially and temporally consistent video grounding.

entries.title: ProCap: Prominence-guided Object Rectification for Faithful and Comprehensive Video Captioning
entries.name: ProCap
entries.description: Ranks detected objects by prominence and iteratively revises captions to reduce omissions and hallucinations without retraining the captioning model.

entries.title: Beyond Binary Preferences: Graded Preference Optimization for Limb-Motion Captioning
entries.name: GM-DPO
entries.description: Weights direct preference optimization by the severity of fabricated or incorrect limb actions, promoting physically faithful, person-specific video captions.

entries.title: MASH-VLM: Mitigating Action-Scene Hallucination in Video-LLMs through Disentangled Spatial-Temporal Representations
entries.name: MASH-VLM
entries.description: Disentangles spatial and temporal attention and introduces Harmonic RoPE to reduce confusion between depicted actions and surrounding scene context.

entries.title: PaMi-VDPO: Mitigating Video Hallucinations by Prompt-Aware Multi-Instance Video Preference Learning
entries.name: PaMi-VDPO
entries.description: Learns video preferences online using prompt-aware augmented clips as rejected inputs, reducing incorrect rejections during hallucination mitigation training.

entries.title: Hallucination Reduction in Video-Language Models via Hierarchical Multimodal Consistency
entries.name: MMA
entries.description: Combines multi-level semantic alignment with progressive training to reduce hallucinations caused by weak discrimination between video and language concepts.

entries.title: Clue Matters: Leveraging Latent Visual Clues to Empower Video Reasoning
entries.name: ClueNet
entries.description: Separately supervises visual clue extraction and answer reasoning, then filters clues for faithful and interpretable video question answering.

entries.title: GraphThinker: Reinforcing Temporally Grounded Video Reasoning with Event Graph Thinking
entries.name: GraphThinker
entries.description: Builds event-based video scene graphs and applies visual-attention rewards during reinforcement fine-tuning to ground temporal reasoning.

entries.title: MACD: Model-Aware Contrastive Decoding via Counterfactual Data
entries.name: MACD
entries.description: Uses model feedback to construct object-level counterfactual video inputs for evidence-grounded contrastive decoding.

entries.title: Enhancing Video Representations with Spatiotemporal-Semantic Residual to Mitigate Hallucinations in Video Large Multimodal Models
entries.name: ViSSRes
entries.description: Trains a lightweight residual aligner on frozen video representations to improve spatiotemporal consistency and alignment with response semantics.

entries.title: Video-ToC: Video Tree-of-Cue Reasoning
entries.name: Video-ToC
entries.description: Localizes visual evidence through a tree of cues and trains reasoning with rewards adjusted to the video's reasoning demands.

entries.title: CCTVBench: Contrastive Consistency Traffic VideoQA Benchmark for Multimodal LLMs
entries.name: C-TCD
entries.description: Uses counterfactual traffic-video counterparts during contrastive decoding to improve the consistency of accident-related judgments without additional model training.

entries.title: VADER: Adaptive Debiasing for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models
entries.name: VADER
entries.description: Adaptively reweights visual attention and contrasts selectively erased evidence to suppress prior-driven video hallucinations without training.

entries.title: Catching Hallucinated Citations in Video-LLM Question Answering: A Self-Verification Pipeline and Verifier Ablation Study
entries.name: GroundedVQA
entries.description: Verifies timestamped video-answer claims by independently re-captioning cited frames and checking textual entailment with a separate model.

entries.title: Target-Checked Reliability Score Refinement for Video Question Answering
entries.name: TRACE-RC
entries.description: Refines learned reliability scores through target-checked evidence across video samplings, improving answer selection while leaving generated answers unchanged.

entries.title: VistaDPO: Video Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Direct Preference Optimization for Large Video Models
entries.name: VistaDPO
entries.description: Optimizes preferences at whole-video, temporal, and object levels using spatially and temporally annotated response pairs.

entries.title: VideoHallu: Evaluating and Mitigating Multi-modal Hallucinations on Synthetic Video Understanding
entries.name: VideoHallu-GRPO
entries.description: Applies group relative policy optimization to help video models recognize physical and logical violations instead of substituting familiar prior expectations.

entries.title: Learning to Decode Against Compositional Hallucination in Video Multimodal Large Language Models
entries.name: TriCD
entries.description: Learns an adaptive controller for triple-path contrastive decoding, combining video perturbations and saliency enhancement to address compositional hallucinations.

entries.title: Sink-Token-Aware Pruning for Fine-Grained Video Understanding in Efficient Video LLMs
entries.name: SToP
entries.description: Identifies attention sink tokens and suppresses them during visual token pruning to preserve fine-grained grounding and hallucination robustness.

entries.title: When Text Hijacks Vision: Benchmarking and Mitigating Text Overlay-Induced Hallucination in Vision Language Models
entries.name: VTHM-MoE
entries.description: Trains specialized experts with dual encoders and adaptive token routing to disentangle misleading text overlays from underlying visual evidence.

entries.title: STEAR: Layer-Aware Spatiotemporal Evidence Intervention for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models
entries.name: STEAR
entries.description: Targets risky decoding steps with layer-specific visual evidence, combining grounding restoration with temporal counterfactual checks.

entries.title: Reinforcing Consistency in Video MLLMs with Structured Rewards
entries.name: Structured Rewards
entries.description: Audits captions as factual and temporal claims, then trains with scene-graph, temporal, and video-grounded self-verification rewards.

entries.title: MultiToP: Learning to Patch Visual Tokens to Mitigate Hallucinations in Video Large Multimodal Models
entries.name: MultiToP
entries.description: Trains a lightweight patcher to selectively replace unreliable visual tokens before generation while leaving the original video model unchanged.

entries.title: AVHBench: A Cross-Modal Hallucination Benchmark for Audio-Visual Large Language Models
entries.name: AVHModel-Align-FT
entries.description: Fine-tunes audio-visual models with benchmark-derived training data to improve cross-modal alignment and robustness against auditory and visual hallucinations.

entries.title: AVCD: Mitigating Hallucinations in Audio-Visual Large Language Models through Contrastive Decoding
entries.name: AVCD
entries.description: Uses modality-aware masking and confidence-guided contrastive decoding to suppress hallucinations across audio, video, and language without training.

entries.title: Enhancing Multimodal LLM for Detailed and Accurate Video Captioning using Multi-Round Preference Optimization
entries.name: mrDPO
entries.description: Improves audio-visual captions through repeated preference optimization and rebirth tuning designed to retain non-captioning abilities.

entries.title: EmotionHallucer: Evaluating Emotion Hallucinations in Multimodal Large Language Models
entries.name: PEP-MEK
entries.description: Combines perception-enhanced prompting with memory-based emotion knowledge to reduce emotion hallucinations without additional training of the multimodal model.

entries.title: Beneath the Scores: Rethinking Hallucination Evaluation for Video Understanding Models
entries.name: Beneath the Scores
entries.description: Intervenes separately on video-agent grounding, observation, and reasoning to test whether benchmark scores predict downstream hallucination risk.
